source:
@@U03985@@
There you'd see me riding in a carriage,
up and down, this way and that in the
noisy traffic, scrambling like scattered heaps
of swarming ants.
And whenever I drove or rode on horseback,
I'd be the center of attention for hundreds of thousands.

@@U03987@@
That could never satisfy me!
It’s all very well that people multiply,
and in their way live comfortably,
learn how to read, get educated—
and yet, in the end,
what it teaches them is rebellion.

@@U03989@@
Then I'd build myself a pleasure palace,
one grand and vast enough to match my worth,
with woods, hills, fields, meadows,
all converted to a splendid park.
Velvety lawns edged with wall-high hedges,
walks straight as a die, cleverly managed
shade, waterfalls leaping from rock to rock,
and fountains, fountains of every sort,
a grand jet of water over there,
and off to the sides a thousand piddling jets
hissing and pissing away.
Ah, and then, of course,
cozy little cottages
built for the loveliest of lovely ladies,
where I would spend endless hours in splendid solitude.
“Ladies,” I say,
for I always think of them in the plural.

@@U03991@@
Mean but modern!
A latter day 萨达纳帕洛斯!
translation:
@@U03985@@
在那里你会看到我乘坐马车，
上下，这边，那边
喧闹的交通，像散乱的堆垛一样混乱
成群的蚂蚁。
每当我开车或骑马时，
我会成为数十万人关注的焦点。

@@U03987@@
那永远不能满足我！
人繁衍是件好事，
并以他们的方式舒适地生活，
学习如何阅读、接受教育——
然而，最终，
它教给他们的是叛逆。

@@U03989@@
然后我会为自己建造一座快乐的宫殿，
足以与我的价值相匹配的宏伟和广阔，
有树林、丘陵、田野、草地，
一切都变成了一个美丽的公园。
柔软的草坪，边缘有墙高的树篱，
走得笔直如死，管理巧妙
树荫，瀑布从岩石跳跃到岩石，
还有喷泉，各种喷泉，
那里有一股巨大的水柱，
两侧还有一千架微不足道的喷气式飞机
发出嘶嘶声和小便。
啊，然后，当然，
舒适的小别墅
专为最可爱的女士打造，
在那里我会在美妙的孤独中度过无尽的时光。
“女士们，”我说，
因为我总是以复数形式思考它们。

@@U03991@@
卑鄙但现代！
末日萨达纳帕洛斯！
